DepartmentL NSU-Finance & Economics
Physical Location of Position (City): Aberdeen

Posting Text:
Northern State University's School of Business is accepting
applications for a full-time, tenure track Assistant Professor of
Economics beginning in Fall 2027.

We seek an economist who will engage students in the practical use
of economic reasoning and evidence. Candidates with interests in
applied economics are especially encouraged. Expertise in
agricultural economics would be valuable to our students and region
but is not required.

Teaching and Faculty
Responsibilities:
The core teaching assignment includes Principles of Microeconomics
and Principles of Macroeconomics, along with International Trade
and International Finance on a rotating basis. Depending on the
candidate's expertise and program needs, there may also be
opportunities to teach Business Statistics, Business Analytics I or
II, and upper-level electives in economics or related areas. The
typical teaching load is 12 credit hours per semester, with courses
offered in face-to-face and online formats.

The successful candidate will advise and mentor students, maintain
an active program of scholarship appropriate to a tenure-track
appointment, and contribute service to the School, university,
profession, and community. Faculty have opportunities to involve
undergraduates in applied projects and to connect course material
with economic issues relevant to the region and beyond.

Required Qualifications:
• Ph.D. in Economics, Applied Economics, Agricultural Economics, or
a closely related field by the start of the appointment. ABD
candidates who expect to complete their degree before then are
encouraged to apply.
• Ability or demonstrated potential to teach the core economics
courses effectively at the undergraduate level.
• Evidence of scholarly activity or a clear plan for continued
research.

*Preferred Qualifications:• An applied
research agenda that connects economic analysis to business,
policy, agriculture, or other real-world questions.
• Teaching or research experience in our high-growth programs
including finance and agricultural business.
• Preparation to teach statistics, business analytics, or
upper-level electives that complement School of Business
programs.
